election._note: Federal, regional and EP elections are held together every 5 years in June (2024 was 9 June, alongside the EP vote); Wikipedia '2024 Belgian federal election'

dissolution._note: The King may dissolve the Chamber only when the federal Government resigns with the consent of an absolute majority of the Chamber, or when the Chamber rejects a confidence motion or carries a no-confidence motion without proposing a successor PM within three days. No confidence-vote command exists at V1.1c, so this refuses the player's command outright. senate.be, 'Introduction in Belgian Parliamentary History'; archive.ipu.org, 'Motion of censure and votes of no confidence'.

formation._note: Government formed by coalition negotiation and appointed by the King; requires the confidence of the Chamber, carried on a simple majority of those voting.
